summary: The MS is open only to current Biochemistry PhD students, and the department sets each student's requirements, so they are checked by hand. The audit counts your graduate units toward the 45 the degree needs.

ESnHRdtY.why: "The BIOC-MS program is only open to existing students in the BIOC-PHD program. Requirements vary by student." Requirements are set individually, so a person checks them.
